claim: High-bandwidth brain links connect cognition to cloud computation.
originalWording: High-bandwidth brain links connect cognition to cloud computation.

sources.title: AI escape velocity: A conversation with Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: Claims are shown as paraphrases unless identified as a verified quotation.

reference.criterion: A high-bandwidth direct neural connection integrates a person’s neocortex with cloud AI.
reference.rationale: Early 2030s is not due; the reference endpoint is 2033. Sensory-interface research is real, but phones and ordinary AI use do not satisfy a direct high-bandwidth neocortex-cloud connection.
